title: Hoffen's Minimal Armor KarateciKagan's Add-on
description: I love Hoffen's, but I think it needs some changes. this pack does that!
body:
I was looking for  non-obcrusive armor set, then I discovered [Hoffen's Minimal Armor](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hoffens-minimal-armor). And I loved it! But some of the textures were not to my liking. so I made some changes!

**DISCLAIMER**: This is an add-on, so if you already dont have the original pack, you need to download it with this too, first reason being it doesnt work properly if you dont and second reason being give the original creator credit

_(If the pack isnt working and the original Hoffen's textures show up try putting this add-on above the original Hoffen's in the resource packs menu so it takes priority [see gallery for further info])_

Changes from the original:

-Diamond and Netherite helmets did not have pixels of the armor in the face area so thats added to help you see what is being worn easily without obcrusing the players face much (and now it looks more symmetric and better imo)

-Most of the chestplates shoulder pads got reverted to their vanilla looks (with it being shorter to match the pack ofc) but some standouts like gold and copper are left same because they look real good 

-ALL of the baby zombie armor textures are re-made from the ground up to be accurate to the pack now instead of getting a completely different texture [see gallery for comparison]. also fixed a texturing error all the baby zombie chestplates had

-The leather armor undyeable brown bits got removed to achieve a smoother look

-Removed the chainmail helmet straps hoffens had, also added a little depth to the textures (I think it now looks better now) and fixed some texturing errors

-The leather straps from the turtle helmet got removed (why were they there in the first place)

-Fixed a texturing error with the copper chestplate and helmet

For configuration with [Baby Makeover](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/baby-makeover) click [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/deneme12111111)

Configurable with both [Fresh Animations: Player Extension](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fa-player-extension) and [Fresh Moves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tras-fresh-player/versions)! (which both looks so cool but I use the former in my own world)

(Configuration with [Torturable Healthbars](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/torturable-healthbars/versions) coming soon!)
